numerical_scope: Selected 12-coefficient classical error curves independently replayed; other retained arrays unchanged; plotting performs no fitting or propagation
former_Figure_6: Validation frontier retained as b; cross-case graph omitted, results in SI Note 1
limitation: Degree-study cost axes are illustrative Cartesian logical bounds only

panel_mapping_from_previous.g: omitted; numerical results in SI Note 1

colorbar: Centered beneath both columns, label below
cost_axis_scope: Sum of one interior Walsh pair-rotation layer per coordinate across three coordinates on a common 64-cell Cartesian grid
panel_b_annotations: Grid-size scaling O((log N_x)^K), fixed coordinate count and degree; N_x and K defined
panel_e_blue: Noiseless ensemble field bias relative to matched continuum Radial field
panel_e_dotted: 1% relative RMS target including sampling and implementation errors

circuit_readout_scope.e_blue: exact ideal-circuit field bias, no finite-shot draws
circuit_readout_scope.f_open_markers: 815 additional ideal shots shared per time between force estimators
circuit_readout_scope.field_815_budget: separate RMS target including sampling and implementation errors
